summary: V1.280 workbook loads cleanly (31 sheets, honesty tabs present); design-pack zip is well-formed with all MANIFEST files non-zero and version-aligned; quality-scorecard floor=4 / release_readiness=4 / allPass=false / ship_ok=false deliberately held. Failures: Executive Summary presents brief-sourced targets as Achieved+PASS; PCB tab says FAB-READY while pcb-stage/Quality say ENGINEERING DRAFT/NOT_FABRICATION_READY; mgu_iron_loss_w and related power/torque quantities disagree across tool blocks (partially disclosed on Checks); Suppliers OBD Stator Windings mpn='(none)' disagrees with is_unresolved_part_number.
commands_run: .venv/bin/python zipfile.ZipFile.testzip() on workbook xlsx and design-pack zip
.venv/bin/python cross-tab scan of torque/iron_loss/magnet_temp/ship_ok/power/rpm labels and values (data_only=True)
.venv/bin/python Executive Summary r38-46 + Verification brief rows source=brief/PASS audit
.venv/bin/python PCB tab KV vs twin pcb-stage.json; PCB_SIDECAR_FILENAMES presence (pcb-stage.json / pcb-stage-result.json)
.venv/bin/python MANIFEST.txt claimed paths vs zip members sizes; workbook version stamp compare
not_checked: Byte-identity of twin DRAFT xlsx vs pack-embedded xlsx (names differ: DRAFT vs design-pack-engineering-workbook)
Full formula dependency graph / every live Excel formula recompute beyond openpyxl cached data_only values
BoM ledger line-by-line cross-check of all 55 parts against Suppliers pinned/OBD lists
pcb/pcb-stage.json (smaller nested copy) vs root pcb-stage.json semantic merge policy
Visual render/PDF content inside the design pack beyond existence and non-zero size
Whether pinned MPNs (e.g. RRIA, Rack Manifold) are real catalogue numbers — only OBD fabrication rule was in scope

findings.claim: Workbook opens without repair under openpyxl data_only=False and data_only=True; xlsx and design-pack zips are well-formed
findings.command: .venv/bin/python -c "from openpyxl import load_workbook; import zipfile; load_workbook(WB,data_only=False); load_workbook(WB,data_only=True); print(zipfile.ZipFile(WB).testzip(), zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP).testzip())"
findings.observed: data_only=False OK sheets=31; data_only=True OK sheets=31; xlsx testzip=None members=134; pack testzip=None members=78
findings.reader_would_conclude: File is a normal Excel workbook and pack; Excel should not prompt for repair

findings.claim: About 31 sheets including honesty tabs Holds, Checks, Decision Register, Questions, Quality
findings.observed: n=31; honesty map: Holds→'Holds & exclusions', Checks→'⚠ Checks', Decision Register→'Decision Register', Questions→'Questions for the customer', Quality→'Quality & Audit'; full list starts Executive Summary…Glossary
findings.reader_would_conclude: Governance/honesty surfaces are present and findable

findings.claim: source=brief values must not be presented as engineering achievements (Target/Achieved/PASS)
findings.where: Executive Summary!A37:I46 (Key specifications & brief compliance); also Verification!A7:H16 source=brief rows
findings.command: .venv/bin/python dump Exec Summary r37-46 data_only=True; dump Verification rows where colA=='brief'
findings.observed: Headers: Brief metric|Target|Unit|Matched contract quantity|Achieved|Direction|STATUS. All 9 rows r38-46 have Target==Achieved and STATUS=PASS with notes 'brief key: … → contract: …'. Examples: Front hardware power class 350/350 PASS; Max rotor speed 19500/19500 PASS; Fpk mass cap 32/32 PASS; Magnet temp limit 150/150 PASS. Verification brief rows r7-16 also PASS with C==D echo (except Max mass 32 vs 28.8).
findings.reader_would_conclude: The design has met every brief metric (including limits and assumptions) because Achieved equals Target with green PASS — even where the 'achievement' is only re-stating the brief input

findings.claim: Magnet temperature: same narrative quantity consistent across tabs
findings.where: Executive Summary!A46 vs ⚠ Checks!A63 vs motor thermal outputs
findings.command: .venv/bin/python data_only values for magnet temp limit / mgu_magnet_temp_c
findings.observed: Exec Summary r46: Target=150 Achieved=150 STATUS=PASS (limit echoed). ⚠ Checks r63: 'Brief target met: magnet_temp_limit_c' design=159.35 limit=150 delta=9.35 STATUS=FAIL ('design must stay ≤ the brief cap'). Thermal tool magnet temp 101.82 also appears on Checks r115.
findings.reader_would_conclude: From Exec Summary alone, magnet temperature compliance is PASS at 150°C; from Checks, the design magnet temp 159.35°C fails the 150°C ceiling

findings.claim: mgu_iron_loss_w / iron loss same name same value across tabs
findings.where: ⚠ Checks!A109; Calculations!B59 / iron_loss_w; design-used 6035.1 vs tool 135.56
findings.observed: Checks r109: 'Tool output superseded: mgu_iron_loss_w' 135.56 vs 6035.1 STATUS=FAIL (delta -5899.54). Calculations r59 label shows 'mgu_iron_loss_w = 6035.1 (≠ tool 135.56)' with tool column 135.56. Dissipation blocks: first-principles total_dissipated_kw_continuous=6.634 vs front_fpk_power_reconcile=12.5336.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Iron loss is either ~136 W or ~6 kW depending on which row/tool they trust; Checks discloses supersession but the dual values remain under the same quantity name

findings.claim: Torque required/delivered and shaft power consistent across high-value tabs
findings.where: Calculations first-principles r24-27 vs front_fpk_power_reconcile r73-75; Verification r21-22; Checks mgu_shaft_torque_nm
findings.command: .venv/bin/python dump Calculations r20-30 and r70-80; Verification r21-22
findings.observed: mgu_shaft_power_kw: 244.4902947 (first-principles) vs 238.88779335 (front_fpk_power_reconcile). mgu_shaft_torque_nm: 119.73 vs 116.99. Contract peak mgu_shaft_torque_max_nm=334 vs calc 119.7 on Verification r21 STATUS=FAIL (rel err 64.16%). Continuous shaft torque 119.7 matches across Verification r22 / Checks / first-principles. mtpa_torque_nm=74.23 and wheel_torque_nm=907.92 consistent where named.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Continuous shaft torque ~119.7 Nm is stable; peak 334 Nm is a different quantity that fails its own closure check; a second reconcile block silently uses different efficiency and yields ~117 Nm / ~239 kW

findings.claim: ship_ok false consistently; rpm/power headline samples
findings.where: Quality & Audit!B109; pcb-stage.json ship_ok; Executive Summary power/rpm
findings.command: .venv/bin/python read ship_ok and key rpm/power cells
findings.observed: ship_ok='false' on Quality & Audit!B109; pcb-stage.json ship_ok=False. Max rotor speed 19500 consistent on Exec/Inputs/Brief/Checks; Verification physics row compares 19500 vs 21450 retention calc with PASS at 10% tol. continuous_power_kw=250 and gear_output_power_kw≈237.156 consistent on primary first-principles path. Exec status A16='DRAFT — 7 open issues'.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Dossier is not ship-ready; headline rpm/power on the primary path are internally consistent

findings.claim: Suppliers OPEN BY DESIGN must not carry fabricated MPNs; is_unresolved_part_number must agree
findings.command: .venv/bin/python scan OBD rows + from lib.homologation_honesty import is_unresolved_part_number
findings.observed: Banner A17='OPEN BY DESIGN — 45 part(s), no supplier yet'. Data rows r19-57,59-63: Manufacturer part number state='TBD (detailed design)' → is_unresolved_part_number True; no letter+digit catalogue-like MPN on OBD. Exception r58 Stator Windings mpn='(none)' → is_unresolved_part_number('(none)')=False (disagreement). Pinned r6-15 use real-looking MPNs (e.g. MKP1848C66012JY5, HASS 100-S) outside OBD.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Open parts are honestly TBD, not fake orderable MPNs; one OBD line uses '(none)' which the unresolved helper does not treat as unresolved

findings.claim: PCB tab matches pcb-stage.json; PCB_SIDECAR_FILENAMES honoured; readiness wording aligned
findings.where: PCB sheet; twin pcb-stage.json; scripts/build-excel-export.py PCB_SIDECAR_FILENAMES; Quality & Audit!B11/D11
findings.command: .venv/bin/python compare PCB KV to pcb-stage.json; check sidecar files; read Quality PCB readiness
findings.observed: Match: disposition=bespoke, electronicPartCount=22, canAuthor/Route/Verify=Yes, boards traction_control+traction_gate_drive, components on board=62=pipeline.components. PCB!A6 starts 'FAB-READY — UNPROVEN IN HARDWARE — DRC-clean…'. Quality!B11=0 D11='readiness: ENGINEERING DRAFT; supplierGerbers=False; hilPresent=False; forgeDraftOnly=True'. pcb-stage: NOT_FABRICATION_READY=True, forgeDraftOnly=True, ship_ok=False, supplierGerbers=False. PCB_SIDECAR_FILENAMES=('pcb-stage-result.json','pcb-stage.json'); root pcb-stage.json exists (50744 B); pcb-stage-result.json absent. pcb/ nested pcb-stage.json is a different smaller stale file (electronicPartCount=4).
findings.reader_would_conclude: From the PCB tab headline the boards are fab-ready; from Quality ship-gate and pcb-stage.json they are still an engineering draft and not fabrication-ready

findings.claim: Design pack zip: every claimed file present and non-zero; workbook version matches pack
findings.command: .venv/bin/python parse MANIFEST CONTENTS paths; compare to ZipInfo.file_size; check V1.280 stamp
findings.observed: claimed paths all present; zero-size files=[]; pack xlsx name '…V1.280-formula-e-front-mgu-design-pack-engineering-workbook.xlsx' shares stamp 20260803-1357-V1.280 with twin DRAFT workbook (filename differs by DRAFT vs design-pack infix only). MANIFEST SKIPPED section honestly lists firmware/ and renders/01-top.png as absent.
findings.reader_would_conclude: The zip is a complete deliverable for what it claims; version is V1.280

findings.claim: quality-scorecard.json floor 4 release_readiness deliberate; allPass false; do not fix release_readiness
findings.command: .venv/bin/python json.load quality-scorecard.json; read Overview release readiness row
findings.observed: floor=4; mean=9.1; allPass=false; deterministicFloor=4; deterministicAllPass=false; section release_readiness score=4 defects include NOT_HOMOLOGATED (45 holds), NOT_FABRICATION_READY, concept-only renders; qualityLoopActionable=false. Overview r34 Release readiness 4 FAIL. ship_ok remains false.
findings.reader_would_conclude: Release readiness is intentionally scored at the floor with allPass false; the dossier does not claim ship/release
